blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) donated medicines to St. Francis of Assisi Parish in Cainta, Rizal through Medicine Donation Program during a ceremonial turnover held on September 24, 2026, at the PCSO Conservatory Building. Medical Services Department Manager Dra. Clarisse Ferrer led the turnover of the medicine packages, reaffirming the agency’s commitment to making basic healthcare assistance more accessible to communities. Healthcare Coordinator Maria Emmaline Yarra personally received the donated medicines on behalf of St. Francis of Assisi Parish.
